This page lists 116 Warp Terminal keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `warp.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Warp Terminal to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t warp.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/warp.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Warp.app`; if Warp Terminal lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Warp Essentials

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘D` | Split Pane Right |
| `⌃⌘L` | Launch Configuration Palette |
| `⌃⌘T` | Open Theme Picker |
| `⌃R` | Command Search |
| `⌃⇧R` | Workflows |
| `` ⌃` `` | Generate |
| `⌘L` | Focus Terminal Input |
| `⌃I` | Warpify Subshell |
| `⌘\` | Warp Drive |
| `⌘O` | File Search |
| `⌘P` | Open Command Palette |

## Blocks

Warp's unique block-based output system.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥↓` | Select the Closest Bookmark Down |
| `⌥⇧⌘C` | Copy Command Output |
| `⌥↑` | Select the Closest Bookmark Up |
| `⌘A` | Select All Blocks |
| `⌘K` | Clear Blocks |
| `⌘B` | Bookmark Selected Block |
| `⌘↓` | Select Next Block |
| `⌘I` | Reinput Selected Commands |
| `⌘↑` | Select Previous Block |
| `⌃M` | Open Block Context Menu |
| `⇧⌘C` | Copy Command |
| `⇧⌘I` | Reinput Selected Commands as Root |
| `⇧⌘S` | Share Selected Block |
| `⇧↓` | Expand Selected Blocks Below |
| `⇧↑` | Expand Selected Blocks Above |

| `⇧⌘⏎` | Toggle Maximize Active Pane |

## Fundamentals

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘-` | Decrease Font Size |
| `⌘0` | Reset Font Size to Default |
| `⌘1` | Switch to 1st Tab |
| `⌘2` | Switch to 2nd Tab |
| `⌘3` | Switch to 3rd Tab |
| `⌘4` | Switch to 4th Tab |
| `⌘5` | Switch to 5th Tab |
| `⌘6` | Switch to 6th Tab |
| `⌘7` | Switch to 7th Tab |
| `⌘8` | Switch to 8th Tab |
| `⌘9` | Switch to Last Tab |
| `⌘=` | Increase Font Size |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘F` | Find |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⌘T` | Open New Tab |
| `⇧⌘T` | Reopen Closed Tab |
| `⌃⇧←` | Move Tab Left |
| `⌃⇧→` | Move Tab Right |
| `⇧⌘{` | Activate Previous Tab |
| `⇧⌘}` | Activate Next Tab |
